description: This file implements a command handler for the 'git remote-ext' command, managing remote extension requests in Git. It includes functionality for parsing URL arguments with embedded placeholders, executing child processes for remote commands, and handling command interactions via standard input/output.

methods.name: char * strip_escapes(const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
methods.description: Parses a URL argument string, handling escape sequences and placeholders, and sets global variables for special placeholders '%G' and '%V'.

methods.name: void parse_argv(struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Splits a command argument string into components, handling escape sequences, and appends them to the argument vector.

methods.name: void send_git_request(int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)
methods.description: Formats and writes a Git request packet to the specified file descriptor, including optional virtual host information.

methods.name: int run_child(const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Starts a child process with specified service and arguments, sends a Git request if applicable, and manages data transfer between pipes.

methods.name: int command_loop(const char * child)
methods.description: Reads commands from standard input, handles 'capabilities' and 'connect' commands, invoking child processes accordingly.

methods.name: int cmd_remote_ext(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git remote-ext' command, performs initial validation and processing.

ctags.name: cmd_remote_ext
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: parse_argv
ctags.pattern: /^static void parse_argv(struct strvec *out, const char *arg, const char *service)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)

ctags.name: send_git_request
ctags.pattern: /^static void send_git_request(int stdin_fd, const char *serv, const char *repo,$/
ctags.signature: (int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)

ctags.name: strip_escapes
ctags.signature: (const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
